categories.main_business_segments: SRA Holdings operates three main business segments: Development, Operation & Construction, and Sales. The Development segment focuses on large-scale mainframe and open system integration, solutions, and open-source support. The Operation & Construction segment provides system and network operation management, including outsourcing. The Sales segment handles packaged software (including licenses), IT equipment, and consulting services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include mainframe and open system integration, open-source software (notably PostgreSQL and related tools), cloud infrastructure (AWS, Oracle ERP Cloud, etc.), and advanced software engineering methods such as formal specification (VDM), model checking, and AI/ML-based development. The company emphasizes high-quality software development, automation tools, and collaborative R&D with academic and industry partners.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in the financial, manufacturing, and healthcare sectors, as well as public institutions and large enterprises requiring mission-critical IT systems. The company also serves hospitals and educational institutions, with no single customer accounting for more than 10% of total sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: SRA Holdings is headquartered in Japan and generates over 90% of its revenue domestically. It also operates subsidiaries in the US, Europe (Netherlands), China, Singapore, India, Serbia, and has strategic partnerships in Vietnam, with a growing focus on Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream and downstream IT service provider, acting as a system integrator, solutions developer, and value-added reseller. It also provides upstream technology development and consulting, especially in open-source and cloud technologies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include transforming the business model towards consulting and SaaS, strengthening cloud and AI/ML capabilities, expanding global and IP-driven business, and enhancing group synergies. R&D focuses on high-quality software, formal methods, AI/ML, cloud, open-source, and new product/service development, with a strong emphasis on talent development and innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through project-based system development, recurring operation and maintenance contracts, packaged software and hardware sales (including licenses), consulting, and support services. Increasingly, SaaS and IP-based services are being developed as part of the business model transformation.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: SRA Holdings competes with major Japanese and global IT service providers, system integrators, and open-source solution vendors. The company differentiates itself through deep technical expertise, open-source leadership, and a strong presence in mission-critical systems for finance and manufacturing, positioning itself as a technology-driven, quality-focused mid-sized player.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated revenue was ¥51.6 billion, with operating profit of ¥7.9 billion and net profit attributable to shareholders of ¥3.4 billion. The company has shown steady top-line growth (9.5% YoY), with a strong balance sheet (equity ratio ~60%) and a focus on stable, sustainable growth, though net profit declined due to special losses related to overseas investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SRA Holdings emphasizes high technical quality, reliability, and deep expertise in both legacy and cutting-edge IT systems, including open-source and cloud solutions. Its value proposition centers on delivering tailored, high-value solutions, leveraging proprietary IP, and providing comprehensive support, with a strong commitment to customer success and long-term partnerships.
